QuestInfo.name: Clearing Things Up
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies wants to clear things up with Blackbull. The mess with the present must still be bothering her.
QuestInfo.1: 10 Boogies told you that Blackbull would never endanger anyone like that, so she wanted to talk to him directly. 10 Boogies seems way too trusting.
QuestInfo.2: 10 Boogies spoke to Blackbull. Wonder how it went?

0.0: Do you remember that gift with all the monsters in it that I gave to Dances with Balrog? Well, I asked Blackbull about it, and he said it was a big mistake. See, #h0#, I told you he was nice. Maybe you should talk to Blackbull yourself.

yes.0: I do hope you and Blackbull can get along.

no.0: Really, Blackbull is so nice. You should see for yourself! Let him win you over.

1.0: Hey, it's you. I'm surprised you haven't ended up as stump feed by now. Ha!\r\nAnyway, whaddya want?\r\n
